content.short: Gate is a long-running global exchange holding reserves across Hyperliquid, Monad and other chains.
content.description: Gate is a long-running global exchange offering spot and derivatives trading across a wide asset list, including tokens on Hyperliquid, Monad and Ethereum. Beyond trading it runs Gate Pay for merchant payments, with an OpenAPI-documented interface for integrators. Institutional and programmatic users connect over its REST and WebSocket APIs.
content.meta: One of the longest-running global exchanges, with sizeable onchain reserves on Hyperliquid and Monad.
